transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you in to see me today?

I can’t keep my mind on one thing anymore. I’ll be fixing a rendering bug, then a Slack ping or a color pattern—or even a siren outside—pulls me into a completely different idea before I finish the line of code.
When did you first start having trouble with your focus and distractibility?
About three months now—since my platform got selected for the Glendale showcase. That’s when I first noticed I couldn’t stay focused like I used to.
During these past three months, have you felt unusually energetic or like your mood was abnormally elevated?

Most days, yeah, I feel really lit up—like I’m unstoppable and Glendale is finally recognizing what I’ve been building. But if my wife or coworkers start slowing me down with their “process,” I get irritated fast.
Before these past three months, have you ever experienced a period where you felt persistently down, depressed, or lost interest in things?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time before this where I felt persistently depressed or lost interest in things.
Before these past three months, have you ever had other times where you felt this same kind of unusually high energy or elevated mood?
I don’t think so. This is the first time I can remember feeling this consistently energized.
Has this increase in energy and distractibility caused serious disruptions or problems in your ability to work or manage your daily life?
Yeah. At work I bypassed the approval process and deployed changes myself, and my employer put me on leave. At home, my wife says my spending and the arguments have made things feel pretty unstable.
During this time, have you heard voices or sounds, or seen things, that other people couldn't hear or see?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing voices or seeing things that other people couldn’t.
